title: stainless steel canning jar handles
text: stainless steel canning jar handles. I purchased these to go with the fairy light project in ball canning jars i started... My house is right on the ocean front and I was hoping for something that wouldn't rust right away... so far so good. They were a tiny bit of an effort to twist onto the jars, but then they twist around easily. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
